stories.title: The far-right AfD wins in eastern Germany
stories.summary: A day after Germany's far-right AfD won a landslide in Saxony-Anhalt's state election, a post listing what it called party leader Alice Weidel's contradictions (an immigrant wife, two adopted children and a home in Switzerland, despite the party's stances on immigration, LGBTQ adoption and nationalism) got 354K likes, more than any other news post on X that day.
